embed:rst .. _cudax-containers-async-vector:
async_buffer -------------
``async_buffer`` is a container that provides resizable typed storage allocated from a given :ref:`memory resource <libcudacxx-extended-api-memory-resources-resource>`. It handles alignment, release and growth of the allocation. The elements are initialized during construction, which may require a kernel launch.
In addition to being type-safe, ``async_buffer`` also takes a set of :ref:`properties <libcudacxx-extended-api-memory-resources-properties>` to ensure that e.g. execution space constraints are checked at compile time. However, only stateless properties can be forwarded. To use a stateful property, implement :ref:`get_property(const async_buffer&, Property) <libcudacxx-extended-api-memory-resources-properties>`.

parameterdescription.para: the type to be stored in the buffer
The properties the allocated memory satisfies
